structure.opening_style: context-setting followed by a problem statement or a major announcement
structure.section_organization: logical progression using clear, descriptive subheadings (often H2/H3)
structure.code_integration: frequent use of code snippets (SQL, Python) accompanied by explanatory text and diagrams
structure.conclusion_style: summary of benefits followed by links to documentation, next steps, or calls to action

phrases_to_avoid: Data silo (unless describing a problem to solve)

communication.value_proposition: Focuses on speed (time to value), cost reduction (TCO), unification of data/AI, and open standards.
credibility_markers: References to open source contributions (Spark, MLflow)
communication.technical_depth: Deep but accessible; bridges high-level business value with low-level implementation details (code, architecture diagrams).
